description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Most-recent XRPL signal events newest-first. Mixes news, whale activity, permissioned-domain lifecycle, Sentinel signals, and RWA issuer flows. Filterable by kind, time range, and min whale USD.

_bypass_key.description: Operator-issued bypass key. Only useful if the server operator gave you one; ignored unless it matches the server's MCP_BYPASS_KEY. Omit it and pay via payment_signature instead.

before_iso.description: ISO 8601 upper bound for backward pagination.

kind.description: Filter by source bucket. Omit for mixed feed.

min_whale_usd.description: USD floor for whale events. Default $1M.

name: xrpl_pulse_recent_events
